set.body: Normative PRD: docs/plans/response-representation-archive-architecture.md, revised 2026-07-26. Migrate the current bridge toward a neutral response kernel, representation planning, archive resources, checked dataset opening, typed interop, and explicit runtime assembly. The decoded response is a non-generic row-major Double ResponseBlock that owns primitive storage directly; no response tensor framework is introduced. FmriDataset and model/fit plans remain pure, while ResponseSource[F], OpenedDataset[F], and runtime interpreters own effects. Completion requires an exact committed baseline and frozen numerical corpus; one nontrivial decoder proven unchanged through memory, LNA-HDF5, and Zarr under DecodeConsistency; unknown-representation inspection; transactional publication; axis-keyed locality receipts; concrete openResponse/openDataset runtime paths; executable import/build guards; legacy translation; JVM and Scala.js laws; and warning-clean compileAll/testAll. The closed bridge bd-01KY6EJNE45WFSAFMNS14V900E remains the compatibility baseline until migration gates replace it.
